note: §4/KS-4, the positive half of `readmitBy: nodeKey`: creation is open, supersession is the node's. `admitBy` and `readmitBy` gate two different acts and a Kind may declare either alone — this one declares only the second, so anybody may put a record here and only the deployment may change one.

kind.description: A caller-named resource anybody may create and only the node key may supersede.
